audience: retail and cannabis store teams that run sales and stock in Brother POS

useCases.title: Find low stock and open purchase orders
useCases.text: List the products with their stock levels. Then list the purchase orders and open one to see its received quantities.

useCases.title: Review the sales of a day
useCases.text: List the sales of a period. Open one sale for its line items and payment method.

useCases.title: Look up a loyalty customer
useCases.text: Find a customer by loyalty card. Then read their recent sales and the rewards they can redeem.

useCases.title: Record a stock count
useCases.text: Record a count or a stock movement for one product. Removals take a negative quantity.

useCases.title: Create or update a customer
useCases.text: Create a customer. The existing record returns if the phone or e-mail is on file. Update the contact fields of a customer.
